# Three.js

Bundled files come from [Three.js r169](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r169): `build/three.module.js`, `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`, and `examples/jsm/loaders/STLLoader.js`, and `examples/jsm/lines/{LineSegments2,LineSegmentsGeometry,LineMaterial}.js`.
The line modules provide screen-space trajectory widths across camera zoom levels.

License: MIT. The upstream license is included in THREE-LICENSE.txt.
